scripts.dev: bunx concurrently -k -n server,web "bun run --cwd apps/server dev" "bun run --cwd apps/web dev"
scripts.test: bun test packages/core/test/*.test.ts packages/db/test/*.test.ts apps/server/test/*.test.ts apps/web/test/*.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc -b packages/core packages/db apps/server && bunx tsc --noEmit -p apps/web
